thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: D2C founders: how did you get your first 100 customers?
thread_summary: Look for a founder asking how others found early customers or validated demand before launch.
text: For us it was a pre-booking list built before launch. We had 1,870 pre-bookings by the time we launched in late October, and about 250 people bought in the first 15 days. The most useful thing we did was ask pre-bookers what stopped them from buying similar products, and the answer shaped the product. The honest lesson: first customers come from people who already trust you, so build that list before you spend on ads.
why: Founder sub where saying who we are is welcome. Real numbers from the playbook.
